title: my desk, labeled
caption:
my desk, with a legend. not to scale.

main monitor: code I'm scared to deploy. second monitor: job boards, minimized.
the mug has been cold since 10am. the plant gets watered more often than I eat.
the keyboard contains lunch and dinner. the cables: do not investigate.

what's the most questionable thing on your desk?

items: watered more often than I eat
slide.kicker: the wallpaper is a beach I can't afford
